subject.title: fix(cli): reject unknown models in config set

question: Should `openclaw config set` reject every affected text-model reference that is unresolved at write time, including references whose availability can depend on configured or later-ready provider catalogs?
rationale: This is an intentional compatibility change at a public CLI/config boundary; source-level comparison with the inference resolver and supported catalog contract is needed before accepting the stricter timing.

options.title: Confirm runtime-equivalent validation
options.body: Approve the write-time check after verifying that it preserves every model reference accepted by the supported inference resolver for the same resulting config.

options.title: Limit validation scope
options.body: Restrict pre-write rejection to references whose invalidity is deterministically known locally, leaving delayed catalog availability to the existing runtime path.

recommendation.title: Confirm runtime-equivalent validation
recommendation.body: Approve the write-time check after verifying that it preserves every model reference accepted by the supported inference resolver for the same resulting config.
